Common Questions

The circle

Isn't this just another women's circle?
No. Most are built around becoming more feminine, and there's a performance in that. Here we call it as it is, so you can put something down instead of picking more up.
Why is a man hosting it?
Because the women who join want a healthy masculine presence in their life, one they are not being led by, competing with, or taking instruction from. Just the masculine holding the room, so they can stop for a change.
I have great friends. Do I need this?
Friendship runs on co-regulation and the women you'd go to are running your operating system. I'm not here to be your friend.
What do you ask of me in the sessions?
Five standards we keep together. Your space: you're here for you, not to contribute to everyone else. Your truth: that's the contribution, and performance stays at the door. Punctuality: show up like it matters, because you do. Curiosity over judgment, of each other and of yourself. And accountability: one intention out of every session, yours to keep.
What happens after four weeks?
Keep building, with the same intention or a new one. Go deeper 1:1 with Reconnect, which includes complimentary access to The Reconnected Woman. Or take what you've gained and celebrate your wins.
I'm not ready yet. Where do I start?
Take the Priority Audit. Ten minutes to find out which priority gives you the most return, with your free results emailed to you.
Are there upsells coming?
No. There's the 1:1 Reconnect Program if you decide you want more, faster, deeper. Join Reconnect and your place in The Reconnected Woman is complimentary. Same work, same direction. More personal.

The practical side

Can I come once before I decide?
Yes. The first session of every month is open and there's no charge for it. Come, sit in it, and decide from the room rather than from this page. After that it's €119 a month, and you're grandfathered: your price never increases as long as you stay.
Can I cancel?
Yes, any time. It's month to month, and your membership runs to the end of the month you've paid for.
What if I'm away for a month?
You can pause once a year, for up to a month, and you keep your price. Ask before your next payment.
Is what I share kept private?
Yes. What you share stays between us. I sometimes draw on a line or a theme from a session in my writing, without anything that could identify you, and I'll always ask you first before using anything that does, like a clip or a testimonial.
Where does it run?
Online, so you can join from wherever you are. Nothing to travel to and nothing to arrange around it.
Do I need to attend every session?
No. Life moves and the group knows it. Come when you can, and know that the women who turn up regularly are the ones who feel it shift.
When do sessions run?
One sitting time, set so it works across the time zones the group is spread over, and we stay fluid with what the group asks for. Come to the open session and you'll see how it sits with your week.
What does the fee include?
Facilitation, hot seat work, resources, and the people you'll meet. It's largely a filter.
